title: Innokin Kwik 35K Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pink Lemonade blends the sweet tang of Raspberry with zesty Lemonade for a light, refreshing vape with a subtle fizz. It’s a bright, uplifting flavour designed for clean, all-day enjoyment. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container for the Innokin Kwik 35K. The mesh-coil pod enhances flavour precision, while the dual-chamber auto-feed system ensures the coil stays saturated. How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
